reasons.text: The legible label photo shows the recalled model LXT-CL-1.0, confirmed by the model check.
The label date code 0722 falls within the recalled range of 0722 to 1223.
Sephora is a listed retailer and the purchase date 2023-05-02 is inside the sale window, with no receipt required.
The destruction photo shows the curling iron with the plug cut off, as the remedy requires, and it is not a repeat of the label photo.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one.
The serial check was skipped by the tool, so the serial rule does not apply to this claim and does not affect the outcome.
